lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A sequence of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns along the mid-lateral line, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, forming a discernible grid of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs concentrated within the lower half of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of small, irregularly sized high-luminance spots distributed across the cranial region anterior to the first gill slit.
